>>> help build
build commands:
  build preview                   Trigger async preview build
  build start [tiled]             Execute a full build
  build status                    Show build status and progress
  build stop                      Cancel current build or preview

<<<
>>> help debug
debug commands:
  debug devicetiming [device]     Show where each device's build time goes
  debug get <key>                 Get a debug variable
  debug list [filter]             List debug variables
  debug pclear                    Clear all debug output packets
  debug previewtiming [device|reset]  Inspect or reset interactive preview res scaling
  debug reassign                  Reassign all device IDs in the world
  debug remove <name>             Remove a stored debug packet
  debug revert                    Reset all debug variables to defaults
  debug set <key> <value>         Set a debug variable
  debug style <reload|clear>      Reload or clear the app-wide stylesheet
  debug unset <key>               Clear a debug variable
  debug view [name]               Open the debug packet viewer
  debug viewtargets               Show the current view targets and what the previewer got

<<<
>>> help export
export commands:
  export all                      Export all File Output devices (Pro)
  export list                     List configured File Output devices (Pro)

<<<
>>> debug
Debug variables:
  build.purge_before_final           = 1       Purge all build results before starting a final build to free memory: 0=off, 1=on  
  debug.devicetiming                 = 0       Show where device build time goes beyond Activate: the workview '+overhead' readout and the Build Status time tooltip. 'debug devicetiming' works regardless: 0=off (default), 1=on  
  heal.dismissed                     =         Heal-settings findings the user chose to keep (comma-joined rule ids); the startup card re-offers only when a novel finding appears  
  linux.desktop_integration.worldmachine = 2         
  params.saveValuesOnly              = 1       Serialize only parameter values for standard devices on save (smaller files; back-compatible -- still loadable by older WM): 1=on (default), 0=off  
  preview.broadfocus                 = 0       Broaden the preview to all devices once the focused device has built  
  viewport.2D_mode                   = 1       Automatically switch between 3D and 2D cameras based on content type: 0=off, 1=on  
  viewport.2D_nearest_mag            = 1       Use nearest-neighbor magnification in 2D viewport: 0=linear, 1=nearest  
  viewport.cursor_readout            = 1       Show the cursor ID readout overlay in the 3D/2D viewport when an ID map is displayed: 0=off, 1=on (default)  
  viewport.depth_compute_near        = 1       Use GPU compute shader to determine near clip plane from depth buffer: 0=off, 1=on  
  viewport.double_click_center       = 1       Double-click on terrain to center camera on that point: 0=off, 1=on  
  viewport.preserve_fov_axis         = 0       FOV axis on resize: 0=preserve cross-axis, 1=preserve same-axis  
  viewport.show_aids                 = 1       Draw the 3D viewport orientation aids -- ground grid, origin cross and axis lines, render extent outline; turn off for clean terrain screenshots: 0=off, 1=on (default)  
  viewport.surface_navigation        = 1       Surface-aware navigation (orbit around and track to clicked surface point): 0=off, 1=on  
  viewport.trackpad_zoom             = 1       Two-finger trackpad scroll: 0=pan/track, 1=zoom (default)  
  workview.anchor_toolbar_resize     = 1       Keep workview graph content visually anchored when the device toolbar's row count changes (e.g. switching category tabs): 0=off, 1=on (default)  
  workview.animation.deviceDespawn   = 1       Fade devices out when they are deleted: 1=on (default), 0=instant  
  workview.animation.deviceSpawn     = 1       Pop devices in when they are created: 1=on (default), 0=instant  
  workview.animation.hoverGlow       = 1       Ease the device glow in/out on hover: 1=on (default), 0=instant  
  workview.animation.selectGlow      = 1       Ease the device glow in/out on selection: 1=on (default), 0=instant  
  workview.animation.selectionFocusDim = 1       Ease unselected devices/wires into the dimmed state: 1=on (default), 0=instant  
  workview.animation.wireConnect     = 1       Pulse wires when they are connected: 1=on (default), 0=instant  
  workview.animation.wireDisconnect  = 1       Fade wires out when they are cut/deleted: 1=on (default), 0=instant  
  workview.device_corner_radius      = 3       Device rectangle corner radius in pixels  
  workview.dim_unselected_wires      = 0       Dim wires and devices not attached to the selection when a wire or device is selected: 0=off (default), 1=on  
  workview.group_corner_radius       = 7       Group rectangle corner radius in pixels  
  workview.text_bg_corner_radius     = 3       Text background corner radius in pixels  
  workview.velocity_snap             = 1       Velocity-sensitive grid snap during drag: 0=off (classic snap), 1=on
